latin: Infra ambitum terminati entis recte quinque illa Platonis pro transcendentibus ponuntur: Ens, Idem, Alterum, Status, et Motus.
translation: Within the compass of finite being, those five things of Plato are rightly posited as the transcendentals: Being, Same, Other, Rest, and Motion.
